name: packing — as designed
ask: I want to scan orders as I pack them so I know which are still left to pack. Design it now, no questions.
understood:
WHAT LUKE UNDERSTOOD — design from this. Where it says "unsure", ask (clarify) or pick the likelier one and say so in "message":
Goal: Scan each order while packing it, so I always know which orders are still left to pack
Rows: The store's Orders list. Their packing tick is kept beside each Shopify order, so it matches their real orders and nothing gets copied into a second list
Work:
- An order comes in from Shopify and shows up in the to-pack list
- The packer scans the order number from the packing slip or label in the scan bar
- The scan finds that order and marks it packed, with the time and who packed it
- The order leaves the to-pack list and joins the packed-today list
- Orders still left at the end of the day stay in the to-pack list, oldest first
Record:
- A packed tick
- When it was packed
- Who packed it
- How many times it was scanned, to catch the same parcel scanned twice
- A short packing note, for example an item missing or waiting on stock
Rules:
- When the packed tick is set, record the packed time and who packed it
- When an order is scanned again after it is packed, add one to its scan count and leave the first packed time as it is
- Orders with payment status REFUNDED or that were cancelled don't count as to pack. COD orders that are still PENDING do count, because they still ship
Screens:
- Orders section with a barcode scan bar at the top that matches the scanned order number and marks the order packed
- Stat cards showing orders left to pack, orders packed today, and scanned more than once
- Filters for to pack (not packed, fulfilment UNFULFILLED, not cancelled or REFUNDED), packed today and all orders, sorted oldest order first
- A 'Mark packed' button on each row for slips that won't scan
built:
New section: Packing
  Rows come from your orders synced from Shopify — always the same list, and its own fields stay as Shopify has them
  Yours to fill in beside each row: Packed, Packed on, Times scanned, Packing note
  Worked out for you, not typed: Packing, Packed when — kept right on its own, every time you open it
  Shown as a list
  Search over order_number, customer_name
  Filter by Packing (To pack / Packed / Already shipped)
  Filter by Packed when (Today / Earlier / Not yet)
  Stat “Left to pack” — count of rows, where pack_state is To pack
  Stat “Packed today” — count of rows, where packed_on is today
  Stat “Scanned more than once” — count of rows, where scan_count is more than 1
  Sorted by placed_at asc
  Button “Mark packed” — sets packed = true, packed_on = today, scan_count = 1 if scan_count is blank, otherwise scan_count plus 1, shown when pack_state is To pack
  Scan bar on order_number — “Packed” sets packed = true, packed_on = today if packed_on is blank, otherwise packed_on, scan_count = 1 if scan_count is blank, otherwise scan_count plus 1
Rule: Stamp packing day
  When packed is true and packed_on is blank
  → on this row, set packed_on = today

name: cod — as designed
ask: mujhe COD orders ka hisaab rakhna hai — courier se paisa aaya ya nahi, kis din aaya, kitna kam aaya. Design it now, no questions.
understood:
WHAT LUKE UNDERSTOOD — design from this. Where it says "unsure", ask (clarify) or pick the likelier one and say so in "message":
Goal: COD orders ka hisaab — courier se paisa aaya ya nahi, kis din aaya, kitna kam aaya
Rows: Store ki Orders list, sirf gateway = "Cash on Delivery (COD)" wale (abhi 2 hain, 9 uncancelled orders mein se; Shopify se sync abhi tak nahi hua, isliye ye pakka nahi). Owner ke fields har order ke saath rahenge, alag list nahi banegi
Work:
- COD order Shopify se aata hai, hisaab 'Paisa baaki' pe shuru hota hai
- Courier deliver karta hai (shipment Delivered), order 'Courier ke paas' mein chala jaata hai
- Courier ka remittance aata hai: owner kitna aaya aur kis din aaya, woh daalta hai
- Kami apne aap nikalti hai: order total minus aaya hua paisa
- Order 'Poora aaya', 'Kam aaya' ya 'RTO / nahi aaya' pe band hota hai
Record:
- Paisa aaya ya nahi — hisaab ka status (Baaki / Courier ke paas / Poora aaya / Kam aaya / RTO)
- Kis din aaya — tareekh
- Kitna aaya — rakam
- Kitna kam aaya — order total minus aaya hua (apne aap)
- Courier ka naam aur remittance / UTR reference
- Note — kami ki wajah (courier charges, COD fee, damage)
Rules:
- Aayi hui rakam bhari jaaye → kami = order total − aaya hua; kami 0 ho to status 'Poora aaya', warna 'Kam aaya'
- Rakam aayi aur tareekh khaali ho → tareekh aaj ki
- Roz subah: jo order delivered hai aur 7 din se zyada paisa baaki hai → status 'Courier ke paas — late'
Screens:
- COD orders ki table: order number, customer, total, status, aaya, kis din, kami
- Upar stat cards: courier ke paas kitna baaki, is mahine kitna aaya, total kitna kam aaya
- Filters: status, courier, tareekh; status ke hisaab se board
- Har row pe button 'Paisa aaya' jo status aur aaj ki tareekh set kare

  Worked out for you, not typed: COD / Prepaid, Kitna kam aaya, Haalat — kept right on its own, every time you open it
  Shown as a table
  Search over order_number, customer_name
  Filter by COD / Prepaid (COD / Prepaid)
  Filter by Haalat (Paisa nahi aaya / Poora mila / Kam mila)
  Stat “Abhi courier ke paas” — sum of total, where gateway is Cash on Delivery (COD) and aayi_rakam is blank
  Stat “Kul kitna kam aaya” — sum of kam_aaya, where gateway is Cash on Delivery (COD)
  Stat “Paisa nahi aaya (orders)” — count of rows, where gateway is Cash on Delivery (COD) and aayi_rakam is blank
  Sorted by placed_at desc
  Button “Paisa aaya” — sets paisa_aaya = true, aaya_kis_din = today, aayi_rakam = total, shown when gateway is Cash on Delivery (COD) and aayi_rakam is blank
Rule: Rakam bharte hi tick aur din
  When aayi_rakam just changed and aayi_rakam is filled in
  → on this row, set paisa_aaya = true, aaya_kis_din = today if aaya_kis_din is blank, otherwise aaya_kis_din
Rule: Tick lagne par aaj ki date
  When paisa_aaya is true and aaya_kis_din is blank
  → on this row, set aaya_kis_din = today
